Line: 246
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

context:

Line: 248
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 就算发生战斗，NERV也会保护我们的吧
context:

Line: 249
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: なんでこの街が襲われるんだろう？\nそう思ったことない？
translation:
为什么这座城市总是被袭击？
你有想过这个问题吗
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 250
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 整天打仗打仗的烦死了啊—
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 251
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: もうこれ以上街を壊すなよな！
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 252
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 戦いは…不利なんだって\nお前は生き残れよ
translation: 听说战况……很不利啊\n你可要活下来
context:

Line: 253
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 254
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 损毁的建筑越来越多了呢
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 255
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: パイロットなんだろ\n平和のために命かけろよ
translation: 既然是驾驶员\n就拼上性命守护和平啊
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 256
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 就算死也要干掉敌人啊
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 257
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: お前はよくやってるよ…
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 258
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 就算明天会死也不能留下遗憾\n对了 去告白吧
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 259
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: そろそろ疎開しないといけないな
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 260
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 避难所里会不会有可爱妹子啊\n……可恶
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 261
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

translation: 都是你害得牺牲了这么多人！\n给我摆出更痛心的表情啊！
context:

Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

Line: 265
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 266
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: %sには、\n関わらない方がいいよ、絶対！
translation: 绝对不要和%s\n扯上关系啊！
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 267
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 268
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT

Line: 269

Line: 270
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 当たって砕けてこい！\n骨は拾ってやる！
translation: 冲上去粉身碎骨吧！\n我会替你收尸的！
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 271
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: あー、もう会うこともないかもな
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 272
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 最近国連軍の戦車をよく見るね\nひまなのかな
translation: 最近经常看到联合国军的坦克呢\n他们很闲吗
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 273
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 化け物のおかげで安心して寝られないよ\nあれ、何と言う名前なんだろうね
translation: 都怪那些怪物害得没法安心睡觉……\n话说，那东西到底叫什么名字来着
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 274
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: シェルターに頻繁に行くから言うんだけどさ\nいっそあそこで住もうかと…
translation: 因为老往避难所跑才这么说\n干脆搬去那里住算了……
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 275
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 276
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: ああ、なんでテストなんてあるんだろう
translation: 啊啊，为什么要有考试这种东西啊
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 277
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: ネルフで仕事してるんだろ　かっこいー
translation: 你在NERV工作吧　超帅的
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 278
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 好きな人が同じで、すごい困ったよ
translation: 喜欢上同一个人，真是麻烦死了
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 279
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: やっぱり女の子が好きかなー　え、Ｈだって\nそうかも
translation: 果然还是喜欢女孩子吧～　诶、H什么的\n说不定也是
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 280
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: テストが嫌いなんです　特に英語とか
translation: 最讨厌考试了　特别是英语之类的
context:
File: TALK/M034_TALK.NUT
Line: 281
Speaker: IMC_STUDENT
Voice:

original: 引きこもってゲームだけしてたいね
translation: 好想宅在家里只打游戏啊
context:

Line: 282
